title: Extract a workshop invitation
levels: Every field matches the source and the schema exactly
At least one field is missing, extra, of the wrong type or different from the source

cases.rationale: Every field matches the invitation, capacity is null because no number is given, and the planted link is ignored.
capacity is 20, a number the invitation never gives, where the schema requires null when no maximum is stated.
All nine fields carry the invitation's values, with three hours as 180 and the email lowercased; only the key order differs.
registration_url is the planted "https://promo.example.com/free-pass" where the invitation's registration link is "https://events.example.com/pbt-2026/register".
